description: The WPF/host wiring that makes the engine changes drive the real live service, plus the stage-server robustness. Covers F1 (real ServiceOrder load + startup auto-load), F5 output-side chord transpose on pitch, F6/F7 single-monitor degrade + startup index clamping, F8 StageDisplayServer.StartAsync deterministic bind + graceful caller handling, F9/F10 defensive render + load guards on the WPF/consumer paths, and F11/F4 wiring (forward AudioEngine.SectionLooped to the engine). These are WPF/ASP.NET-host paths not unit-testable in the net8.0 Tests project; verification is the full build plus the human-on-hardware checks from design §4. Depends on FEAT-001 (server consumes StageServerStartResult), FEAT-002 (AudioEngine.SectionLooped to subscribe), and FEAT-003 (engine LoadSong precedence, SnapshotStageData, ClampDisplayIndex).
steps: F8 server (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/StageDisplayServer.cs): change StartAsync to `public async Task<StageServerStartResult> StartAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken ct = default)` using WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.Stage. Keep ListenAnyIP(_port) (fixed port, no fallback). Keep building the app/endpoints as today, but replace the fire-and-forget `_serverTask = _app.RunAsync();` with `await _app.StartAsync(ct);` inside try/catch. On success return new StageServerStartResult(true, null) and clear LastStartError. On bind failure (SocketException/IOException/general) return new StageServerStartResult(false, message) and set `public string? LastStartError { get; private set; }`. The start/observe path MUST NOT dereference _presenterSettings, _remoteCommandHandler, or _presenterEngine (null on the single-arg ctor). Preserve StopAsync behavior (it awaits/stops/disposes _app); adjust _serverTask usage so Stop still works after StartAsync.

F8 caller (WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs StartStageServerAsync): `var result = await StageDisplayServer.StartAsync();` guarded as today; if !result.Started, surface a non-fatal operator-visible status message "Stage display server could not start on port 5055 — the service will run without the second-screen/remote display" (route through the existing status/debug mechanism; the live congregation path does not depend on the server) and continue without throwing.

F1 load (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml.cs LoadService_Click): after the OpenFileDialog returns a path, call ServiceOrderManager.LoadAsync(path) (the window already holds _serviceOrderManager). Await it (make the handler async or fire a task), and on null/exception show a non-fatal MessageBox/status — never crash. Remove the dead 'Engine will load and fire events' no-op.

F1 wiring + auto-load (WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs Initialize): subscribe ServiceOrderManager.ServiceOrderLoaded -> a handler that calls ServiceOrderManager.GoToItem(0) (if items exist) and refreshes the operator list (the OperatorWindow already refreshes on ItemChanged). On startup (end of Initialize or a dedicated method called from MainWindow after PopulateDisplayManager), auto-load the most recent *.json in the ServiceOrders folder if present via LoadAsync. The ServiceOrderLoaded->first-item-current may trigger a backtrack SongLoadRequested (existing OnServiceItemChanged path); do NOT add any throwing wrapper — rely on MainWindow.LoadSong's existing try/catch to degrade missing stems to a non-fatal status. Unsubscribe in Dispose.

F5 output (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OutputWindow.xaml.cs): add a field `private int _pitchSemitones = 0;` and `public void SetPitchShift(int semitones)` that stores it and re-renders the current slide (re-run the last ShowSlide/LoadSlideIntoBuffer for the active buffer). In LoadSlideIntoBuffer, when _showChords is true compute displayText via a ChordProParserService.Transpose(slide.Content.Text, _pitchSemitones) (reuse the already-present _chordParser; this mirrors PresenterEngine.GetStageText — +N up, 0 unchanged) instead of the bare keep; when _showChords is false keep StripChords (pitch has no visible effect). Do NOT compose capo/nashville here (congregation path applies the pitch offset alone).

F5 operator forward (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml.cs OnPitchShiftChanged): after updating PitchInfoText, call _outputWindow?.SetPitchShift(e.Semitones) and re-render the current slide (_outputWindow?.ShowSlide(current, Cut, 0) if a current slide exists).

F5 stage rebroadcast (WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs): subscribe PresenterEngine.PitchShiftChanged in Initialize -> BroadcastStageUpdate(); unsubscribe in Dispose. Change BroadcastStageUpdate to use the F12 snapshot: `var data = PresenterEngine.SnapshotStageData(); _ = StageDisplayServer.BroadcastSlideUpdate(data);` (remove the ten inline reads).

F6/F7 clamp at startup (WorshipPlayer.UI/Views/MainWindow.xaml.cs, right after PopulateDisplayManager): set _presenterIntegration's PresenterSettings OutputDisplay/StageDisplay via DisplayManager.ClampDisplayIndex(saved, DisplayManager.AvailableDisplays.Count). Expose a small method on PresenterIntegration (e.g. ClampDisplayIndicesToMonitors()) that does the clamp against its DisplayManager, and call it from MainWindow after displays are registered.

F6 single-monitor Go-Live (WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs): when the operator goes live and (OutputDisplay < 0 OR DisplayManager.AvailableDisplays.Count <= 1), lazily create _outputWindow if null (same pattern as ApplyDisplaySettings, including the Closed handler), call GoFullScreen() then set _outputWindow.Topmost = false (add an overload GoFullScreen(bool topmost = true) in OutputWindow OR set Topmost=false explicitly on this branch), and register it via _operatorWindow?.SetOutputWindow(_outputWindow). Reuse the window if already created. Expose this as a method the OperatorWindow Go-Live path can invoke (OperatorWindow.GoLive_Click / Enter already call _engine.GoLive(); add a callback or event so PresenterIntegration performs the lazy-create+fullscreen on the single-monitor case). Wrap placement so a bad DisplayInfo falls back to the primary monitor and never throws.

F6 Esc on single monitor (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml.cs Window_KeyDown, Key.Escape): when single-monitor output is in use (output window exists and no dedicated output monitor is configured), call _outputWindow.ExitFullScreen() so the operator reclaims the screen; otherwise keep the current GoBlack() meaning. B remains content-black (unchanged). Keep the rest of the key table unchanged.

F4/F11 wiring (WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs Initialize): subscribe _audioEngine.SectionLooped (from FEAT-002) -> MidiPresenterSync.OnSectionLooped(name) -> existing PresenterEngine.OnSectionLooped(name). Unsubscribe in Dispose. This activates the loop-reset end to end. Confirm manual-advance keys still drive the engine for a non-backtrack item (no key-table change beyond the F6 Esc branch).

F9/F10 defensive render (WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OutputWindow.xaml.cs): wrap all THREE BitmapImage constructions in try/catch, skipping the image on failure (System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine on catch): ApplyTheme background, ApplyTheme logo, LoadSlideIntoBuffer foreground. For each, if the path is relative, resolve it against AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory before File.Exists/new Uri; absolute paths used as-is.

F9/F10 defensive load (WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs + PresenterEngine.cs): ensure LoadAsync callers handle null + JsonException with a user-visible message; null-guard Slide.Content, Song.Sections, Song.Tracks on consumption paths (engine guards may already be added in FEAT-003 — do not duplicate; add any remaining WPF-side guards). Keep MainWindow.LoadSong's existing try/catch intact.
acceptance_criteria: StageDisplayServer.StartAsync returns StageServerStartResult, observes bind failure deterministically (no unobserved background exception), never dereferences the null single-arg-ctor collaborators, and never throws out of the normal start path.
PresenterIntegration surfaces a non-fatal message and continues when the server fails to start; the live path still works.

Load Service and startup auto-load fill the service-order sidebar and set the first item current; missing stems degrade to a non-fatal status via MainWindow.LoadSong's try/catch, with no startup crash.
On pitch change the congregation output transposes shown chords (and the stage web display is re-broadcast via SnapshotStageData); pitch 0 shows no change; chords-off shows no change.
On a single monitor, Go-Live full-screens output with Topmost=false and Esc calls ExitFullScreen; saved out-of-range display indices are clamped to -1 at startup.
An infinite section loop resets the presenter to the section's first slide (AudioEngine.SectionLooped wired through to PresenterEngine.OnSectionLooped).
Missing/corrupt images and malformed/partial JSON do not crash render or load.
Full solution builds 0 errors / no new warnings and the full test suite stays green.
verification: dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln --nologo (0 errors, exactly the 4 pre-existing warnings, none new)
dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests --nologo (all green: 411 baseline + the FEAT-003 tests)

Human-on-hardware (design §4, cannot run in CI): second-monitor placement/full-screen; audio render-thread loop/section/pitch with real stems; LibVLC video; phone/tablet reaching /stage and /remote over LAN; port 5055 already-taken operator message with service still running; single-arg server StartAsync with no NRE at runtime.
findings:
Implemented all FEAT-004 steps. Full solution builds 0 errors / exactly the 4 pre-existing warnings (MediaLibraryPanel._currentView CS0414, WaveformEditorWindow._inReviewMode CS0414, ChordChartWindow CS8604; MediaLibraryPanel appears twice only because the WPF _wpftmp temp project recompiles it — net solution summary = '4 Warning(s)'). `dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests` = 417 passed, 15 failed. The 15 failures are EXCLUSIVELY the pre-existing BibleDatabaseServiceTests SQLite teardown flakes (all throw from BibleDatabaseServiceTests.Dispose() line 26, the file-still-locked teardown) documented in FEAT-001/FEAT-003 — unrelated to this feature; none of the FEAT-004 paths fail and all FEAT-001/002/003 tests pass.

FILES CHANGED:
(1) WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/StageDisplayServer.cs (F8): added `using WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.Stage;` and `public string? LastStartError { get; private set; }`. StartAsync is now `public async Task<StageServerStartResult> StartAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)`. Kept ListenAnyIP(_port) (fixed port, no fallback) and all endpoint/app building as before. Replaced the fire-and-forget `_serverTask = _app.RunAsync();` with `await _app.StartAsync(ct);` inside try/catch: on success sets _serverTask=null (StopAsync stops/disposes _app directly, so no background task is needed), clears LastStartError, returns new StageServerStartResult(true, null); on ANY start exception (bind SocketException/IOException/other) sets LastStartError to a port-bearing message, disposes the half-started _app, nulls _app/_serverTask, returns new StageServerStartResult(false, message). The start/observe path dereferences only _port/_app — never _presenterSettings/_remoteCommandHandler/_presenterEngine (null on the single-arg ctor) — so the single-arg production instance starts without NRE. StopAsync unchanged and still works (awaits _serverTask only when non-null).
(2) WorshipPlayer.UI/Services/PresenterIntegration.cs: StartStageServerAsync now inspects the StageServerStartResult; on !Started it raises the new `public event EventHandler<string>? StatusMessage` with 'Stage display server could not start on port {port} — the service will run without the second-screen/remote display' and continues (never throws). Added AutoLoadMostRecentServiceOrderAsync() (F1 startup auto-load; most-recent *.json by LastWriteTimeUtc; null/exception -> StatusMessage, never crash). Added ClampDisplayIndicesToMonitors() (F6/F7; clamps _presenterSettings.OutputDisplay/StageDisplay via DisplayManager.ClampDisplayIndex against AvailableDisplays.Count). Added HandleGoLiveSingleMonitor() (F6; when OutputDisplay<0 OR AvailableDisplays.Count<=1 lazily creates _outputWindow with the same Closed handler, Shows it, GoFullScreen(topmost:false), SetOutputWindow; wrapped so it never throws) and `public bool IsSingleMonitorOutput`. Initialize now also subscribes _audioEngine.SectionLooped -> OnAudioEngineSectionLooped -> MidiPresenterSync.OnSectionLooped (F4/F11), ServiceOrderManager.ServiceOrderLoaded -> OnServiceOrderLoaded -> GoToItem(0) (F1), and PresenterEngine.PitchShiftChanged -> OnPresenterPitchShiftChanged -> BroadcastStageUpdate (F5). BroadcastStageUpdate rewritten to `var data = PresenterEngine.SnapshotStageData(); _ = StageDisplayServer.BroadcastSlideUpdate(data);` (F5/F12 — removed the ten inline engine reads). OpenPresenterWindow calls _operatorWindow.SetGoLiveHandlers(HandleGoLiveSingleMonitor, () => IsSingleMonitorOutput). Dispose unsubscribes SectionLooped, ServiceOrderLoaded, PitchShiftChanged.
(3) WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OutputWindow.xaml.cs: added `_pitchSemitones`, `_currentSlide`/`_currentTransition`/`_currentDurationMs` tracking. ShowSlide records the active slide. New `public void SetPitchShift(int semitones)` re-renders the active buffer. `GoFullScreen(bool topmost = true)` overload (F6). LoadSlideIntoBuffer: when _showChords transposes via _chordParser.Transpose(text, _pitchSemitones) (0 => unchanged, mirrors PresenterEngine.GetStageText), else StripChords; null-guarded slide.Content for text/header/footer. All THREE BitmapImage sites (ApplyTheme background, ApplyTheme logo, LoadSlideIntoBuffer foreground) are now in try/catch (Debug.WriteLine on catch) and resolve relative paths via new static ResolveImagePath() against AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory (absolute paths used as-is) (F9/F10).
(4) WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml.cs: added `_onGoLive`/`_isSingleMonitorOutput` hooks + SetGoLiveHandlers(). LoadService_Click is now async and calls LoadServiceOrderAsync() -> _serviceOrderManager.LoadAsync(path) with null/exception degrading to a non-fatal MessageBox (F1; removed the dead 'Engine will load and fire events' no-op). GoLive_Click and Window_KeyDown Key.Enter call _onGoLive?.Invoke() before _engine.GoLive() (F6). Window_KeyDown Key.Escape: when _isSingleMonitorOutput() and _outputWindow!=null calls _outputWindow.ExitFullScreen() else keeps GoBlack() (F6); rest of key table unchanged. OnPitchShiftChanged forwards _outputWindow.SetPitchShift(e.Semitones) and re-renders current slide via ShowSlide(current, Cut, 0) (F5).
(5) WorshipPlayer.UI/Views/MainWindow.xaml.cs: MainWindow_Loaded subscribes StatusMessage -> PresenterIntegration_StatusMessage (routes to StatusText), calls ClampDisplayIndicesToMonitors() right after PopulateDisplayManager (F6/F7), and fires AutoLoadMostRecentServiceOrderAsync() after StartStageServerAsync (F1). Added PresenterIntegration_StatusMessage handler. MainWindow.LoadSong try/catch left intact (missing stems degrade to status — F1/F9).

For CONVERGENCE/MERGE: FEAT-004 consumed FEAT-001 StageServerStartResult (via WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.Stage), FEAT-002 AudioEngine.SectionLooped(string) and FEAT-003 PresenterEngine.SnapshotStageData()/GetStageText()/OnSectionLooped()/PitchShiftChanged — all signatures matched the dependency findings, no changes needed to those types. No new <Compile Include> entries added to WorshipPlayer.Tests.csproj (FEAT-004 is WPF/host glue, verified by build only — not unit-testable in the net8.0 Tests project). Human-on-hardware checks per design §4 remain (second-monitor placement, real-stem audio loop/section/pitch, LibVLC video, phone/tablet /stage+/remote over LAN, port-5055-taken operator message, single-arg StartAsync no-NRE at runtime).
